_comment: Official API prices as of 2026-11-09, in USD per 1 million text tokens, Paid Standard (not Free/Batch/Flex/Fast/Priority). input = cache miss; cache_hit = cache read; output includes billed reasoning/thinking tokens. All _ keys are documentation only and are IGNORED by the loader; they do not enable automatic billing features. Each model entry also carries optional provider metadata for catalog alignment; it is preserved on write but does not affect billing or routing.

_schema.key_format: Exact provider model ID; keys starting with _ are metadata, not models. Aliases and snapshots have their own runtime entries. A model entry replaces the whole built-in price for that key rather than merging field by field.

price_fields.provider: Optional catalog metadata: openai, gemini, deepseek, or anthropic. Preserved across control-plane writes but not used for billing or routing.
price_fields.cache_hit: Optional. Cached prompt-token price. Omitted when caching is unsupported or no rate is published; the loader reads a missing value as 0, which is not a claim that caching is free.
price_fields.output: Required. Completion price, including billed reasoning/thinking tokens where the provider charges them as output.
price_fields.off_peak: Optional object with input, cache_hit, and output used outside every peak_windows entry. Only models that declare both off_peak and peak_windows get time-based pricing.
price_fields.peak_windows: Optional array of 'Mon-Fri HH:MM-HH:MM UTC' windows. The window itself is peak; off_peak applies outside all windows. The parser does not model provider-specific holidays.

tier_semantics.standard: All runtime entries use the Paid Standard synchronous tier. Free, Batch, Flex, Fast/Priority, and fine-tuned rates are not mixed into these numbers.
tier_semantics.long_context: Runtime entries use short-context rates where providers publish tiers. Higher long-context rates are recorded in _long_context_reference but are NOT applied automatically, so estimates may understate charges for large prompts.
tier_semantics.additional_charges: Cache writes, cache storage, tools/search/grounding, Fast mode, data-residency uplift, and separately priced audio/image/video tokens are recorded in _additional_charges_reference and are NOT calculated by the current loader.
tier_semantics.missing_values: Unpublished or unavailable metadata values are omitted rather than invented. Do not treat an omitted cache_hit or long-context tier as a free charge.

_schema.runtime_behavior: This file IS read for cost accounting, unlike model_capabilities.json. Entries override the inline observability.model_prices layer and built-in defaults per key. Invalid JSON or negative prices are logged and skipped so the agent keeps running. Control-plane writes serialize only runtime model entries, so _ metadata is documentation and may be dropped when the file is rewritten.
_schema.source_policy: Official provider pricing, model, lifecycle, and caching documentation only. No unpublished model IDs or rates are invented; published dates are recorded in _lifecycle_notes and _scheduled_changes_reference for maintenance.

_limitations: Runtime entries use short-context rates where tiers exist: OpenAI <=272K input tokens; Gemini Pro <=200K prompt tokens. Long-context rates in _long_context_reference are NOT applied automatically, so runtime estimates may understate actual charges.

OpenAI cache writes, Gemini cache storage, tools/search/grounding, and separately priced audio/image/video tokens are NOT covered. The multimodal model entries below cover text-token components only, not the full cost of a session or media generation.
cache_hit is omitted when caching is unsupported or its rate is unpublished. This does NOT mean caching is free; the current loader reads missing values as 0.
Scheduled price/routing changes in _scheduled_changes_reference are NOT applied automatically. Update runtime entries before their effective dates.

DeepSeek excludes Chinese public holidays from peak periods. The application's peak_windows parser does not support holiday calendars, so it may overestimate charges during nominal peak hours on holidays.
Model availability depends on the account, region, and access approval. This list is based on public documentation, not paid inference calls or authenticated models.list requests.
This file overrides defaults per model rather than replacing the entire built-in table. Removing an obsolete ID from this file does not remove the application's built-in default for that ID.

Anthropic runtime entries use the standard synchronous price tier. Claude Haiku 5.5 prompts over 100,000 input tokens are billed at higher rates recorded in _long_context_reference, and those rates are NOT applied automatically.
Anthropic cache writes, Fast mode, data-residency uplift, web search, and code-execution container fees are NOT covered by the flat token entries.
Anthropic deprecated models are listed only while they remain callable; models already retired on the first-party Claude API are excluded.

_scope.included: Active, preview, and deprecated text/reasoning/coding models that have not shut down; verified aliases/snapshots; text-token components of multimodal models with published text input and output rates.
_scope.excluded: Models that have shut down, embeddings, moderation, fine-tuned/custom pricing, media-only models without text output prices, and open-weight models without official hosted API prices. No unpublished model IDs or rates are invented.
_scope.gemini_latest_note: These aliases are officially listed, but their current targets are unverified; no prices are guessed.
_scope.managed_agents_note: Billed according to the underlying models and tools, not a single fixed input/cache/output price triplet per agent.
_scope.deepseek_retired_note: The official changelog states that both IDs were discontinued on 2026-07-24. Use deepseek-flash; the version names DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 are not documented API model parameter values.

uncertain_ids.gemini-3-pro-preview: Lifecycle documentation lists shutdown on 2026-03-09, while the changelog describes routing to 3.1 Pro. Excluded because the alias status is contradictory.
uncertain_ids.gemini-omni-1.1-flash: Pricing lists text tokens, but the model card lists Video output only; excluded from the text LLM catalog.
uncertain_ids.gpt-5.5-cyber-preview: Pricing uses gpt-5.5-cyber; an alias relationship with the -preview ID is unverified. Rates are not copied to the -preview ID.

_lifecycle_notes.openai_snapshot_note: The family shutdown dates above also apply to the corresponding snapshots in this file; see the official deprecation notices.
_lifecycle_notes.restricted_openai: Cyber/Daybreak and Rosalind require access approval; gpt-6-astra-law is a legal model configuration. Daybreak aliases are deprecated and may change targets.
_lifecycle_notes.gemini_legacy_access: gemini-2.5-pro, gemini-2.5-flash, and gemini-2.5-flash-lite are restricted to existing users. 2.5 Pro/Flash have been deprecated since 2026-11-02; Flash-Lite is not yet deprecated.
_lifecycle_notes.gemini_image_deprecated: gemini-3.1-flash-image is deprecated according to the 2026-10-06 changelog. gemini-2.5-flash-image is deprecated and shuts down on 2027-03-15.
_lifecycle_notes.gemini_live_note: Native audio Live responds with AUDIO and transcription, not an ordinary text response modality. Text rates cover text billing components only. The earliest shutdown date for 3.1 Flash Live Preview and native-audio-12-2025 is 2026-11-17.
_lifecycle_notes.openai_image_note: gpt-image-1.5 and chatgpt-image-latest document image/text output; text output billing includes reasoning. They are not ordinary Chat Completions models, and these rates do not cover the full cost of image generation.
_lifecycle_notes.anthropic_retired_excluded: claude-opus-4-1-20250805, claude-opus-4-20250514, and claude-sonnet-4-20250514 are retired on the first-party Claude API and are excluded even though historical price rows remain.
_lifecycle_notes.anthropic_deprecated: claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 has been deprecated since 2026-09-30 and retires on 2026-11-30; its alias is included only while still callable.
_lifecycle_notes.anthropic_aliases: Before the 4.6 generation, dateless Claude API IDs are convenience aliases that resolve to the most recent dated snapshot. Starting with 4.6, dateless IDs are pinned canonical snapshots, not evergreen aliases.
_lifecycle_notes.anthropic_restricted: claude-mythos-5-1 and claude-mythos-5 require verification through Anthropic's access programs. They share Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Fable 5 specifications and prices respectively.
_lifecycle_notes.anthropic_long_context: Claude 4.6 and later models except Claude Haiku 5.5 include the full 1M context at standard rates. Claude Haiku 5.5 is priced by prompt length as recorded in _long_context_reference.

_long_context_reference._note: DOCUMENTATION ONLY: the loader does not use this object. Higher rates apply based on prompt/request/session length, not just tokens above the threshold. Snapshots and aliases use the corresponding parent/target model's tier.
_long_context_reference.anthropic_note: For Claude Haiku 5.5, a request whose prompt exceeds 100,000 tokens pays the higher rates for that whole request. Prompt length counts all input tokens, including cache reads and cache writes. Each request is priced independently.
_long_context_reference.unresolved: gpt-5.6-cyber: the model page describes a surcharge above 272K, but the central pricing table shows '-' for long context. No long-context rates are invented.

_additional_charges_reference._note: DOCUMENTATION ONLY: the current model_prices loader does not calculate the following charges.
_additional_charges_reference.openai_cache_write: For models with cache-write rates, 30m = 1.25x input and 12h = 2.5x input at the applicable context tier. The write rate REPLACES the ordinary input rate for write tokens; it is not added on top. Applies to GPT-6 Astra/Sol/Terra/Luna/Cyber/Rosalind and GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna/Cyber where official write rates are published.
_additional_charges_reference.gemini_argon_cache: Implicit caching only; explicit caching is not supported.
_additional_charges_reference.openai_endpoint_uplift: Data residency/regional processing: +10% for eligible models released on or after 2026-03-05. FedRAMP endpoints also incur +10%; stacking rules are not inferred.
_additional_charges_reference.anthropic_cache_write: A 5-minute cache write costs 1.25x base input; a 1-hour cache write costs 2x. Cache reads cost 0.1x base input, except 0.025x on Claude Fable/Mythos 5.1 and 0.05x on Claude Opus 5.5/Sonnet 5.5. These are USD per 1M tokens at the applicable model tier and replace, rather than add to, the ordinary input rate for those tokens.
_additional_charges_reference.anthropic_batch: The Message Batches API charges 50% of standard input and output prices. Prompt-caching and batch discounts can stack.
_additional_charges_reference.anthropic_data_residency: Claude 4.6 and later models using inference_geo=us incur a 1.1x multiplier on input, output, cache writes, and cache reads. Global routing uses standard prices.
_additional_charges_reference.anthropic_fast_mode: Fast mode: Claude Opus 5.5 $8 input/$40 output per 1M tokens; Claude Opus 5 and Claude Opus 4.8 $10/$50. Fast mode is not available with the Batch API.
_additional_charges_reference.anthropic_tools: Web search costs $10 per 1,000 searches plus token costs. Web fetch has no additional charge beyond tokens. Code execution is $0.05 per container-hour after 1,550 free hours per month and is free when used with current web search/web fetch tools.

_scheduled_changes_reference._note: DOCUMENTATION ONLY; no automatic date-based switching. All rates remain in USD per 1 million tokens, except storage rates, which are per hour.

2026-12-01.gpt-5.6-sol: The promotion ends on 2026-11-30; post-promotion prices are not published in the sources checked. Recheck the gpt-5.6 and gpt-daybreak-blue-latest aliases as well.

2027-01-01.alias_note: gemini-3.7-flash and gemini-3.5-flash follow their targets' rates; gemini-2.5-pro follows 3.8 Flash after routing changes on 2026-12-01.
2027-01-01.gpt-6-astra-law: Promotional pricing is guaranteed at least through 2026-12-31; recheck rather than assuming any unannounced changes.
